content.short: Dappad connects Layer2 projects with early investors.
content.description: Dappad Launchpad links Layer2 projects with early investors to support token launches and showcase success stories for both sides. The platform aims for a smooth, secure, and user-friendly journey from concept to launch, helping projects attract backing while giving investors clearer paths to participate. It uses an account abstraction model that simplifies user interactions and workflows, enabling straightforward actions without compromising security or control.
